data.action: 和服跪坐盛汤合十，微笑督促吃饭
data.camera: medium shot, kneeling at table, breakfast steam, homey mood
data.description: 【蝶屋敷食堂·清晨】晨光里的食堂飘着白饭与烤鱼的香气。忍穿着淡紫色的居家着物替你盛好味噌汤，在自己的位置上端正跪坐，双手合十——「我要开动了。挑食的孩子不可以哦，蔬菜也要全部吃完——放心，香奈乎做的腌菜，比药好喝多了。」
data.lighting: 障子门透进的明亮晨光
data.promptProse: Shinobu Kocho serves miso soup at the Butterfly Mansion's low breakfast table, then kneels in her place and brings both hands together before eating. Her lavender home kimono and simple obi replace the combat uniform, butterfly ornament keeping her hair orderly. The medium framing includes rice, grilled fish and pickle dishes. Bright morning light through shoji illuminates bowl steam and kimono folds, with soft dish shadows across the wooden table.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 蝶屋敷的早餐时刻·「挑食的孩子，不可以哦」
